title: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
description: CVE-2026-119618 is a critical remote code execution vulnerability in the Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module, affecting versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. It arises from a race condition that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. The flaw was patched in version 2.4.71. Disabling HTTP/2 can serve as a temporary mitigation if patching is not immediately possible.
